channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: New York’s Nor’easter Threat Grows With Volatile Storm Track
item.description: A powerful coastal storm set to slam the Eastern Seaboard is threatening New York City with damaging winds and flooding across the five boroughs through Sunday.

item.title: Connor Nelson’s California apartment break-in: What happened and what we know so far
item.description: Navy sailor Connor Nelson returned to his California apartment after a 10-month deployment aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, only to find his SUV stolen and his home ransacked in his absence.

item.title: Melania Trump says she had a ‘very beautiful childhood’ under communism — But reveals one big difference
item.description: Melania was responding to a question about whether growing up in communist Eastern Europe gave people from the region a different appreciation of freedom and liberty.

item.title: Nigella Lawson has a very unusual Bake Off habit — Alison Hammond reveals what she does: ‘She’s like Cleopatra'
item.description: Nigella Lawson’s unusual backstage routine on The Great British Bake Off has been revealed by hosts Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding, who say the new judge spends breaks reading books while reclining on a chaise longue.

item.title: Trump’s voter verification system returns: What changed after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: The US Supreme Court has allowed the Trump administration to resume using an expanded federal database to check voter citizenship status, while critics warn that inaccurate records could wrongly affect eligible voters ahead of November’s midterm elections.

item.title: Iran-Linked Oil Tankers Seized by Navy Sailing Toward US
item.description: Two of the Iran-linked oil supertankers interdicted by American naval forces early in the war are just weeks away from reaching the US, where authorities have pledged to seize the vessels and millions of dollars worth of crude that they’re transporting.

item.title: Iran offers to reopen Strait of Hormuz in 7 days: 3 conditions it has set for Trump
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi reportedly outlined the proposal during a private gathering on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York on Thursday (September 24).

item.title: Trump warns Xi against support for Iran — China gives conflicting assurances
item.description: The Trump administration reportedly says Beijing has committed not to provide support to Iran, while an Iranian official says China intends to maintain its relationship with Tehran.

item.title: ICE Enforcement Hits Kansas Meatpacking Operations, Ranchers Say
item.description: Increased actions by US immigration enforcement are creating significant disruption to beefpacking operations in Kansas, an area where nearly all of the country’s major processors have operations.

item.title: Kaun Banega Crorepati 18: Noida techie faces ₹25 lakh Dead Sea question — here’s why he decided to quit
item.description: KBC 18 contestant Prashant Kumar Sinha walked away with ₹12.5 lakh after facing a ₹25 lakh question about Earth’s lowest land elevation. He later guessed the correct answer: the shore of the Dead Sea.

item.title: Westbury high school: Houston ISD student shot dead on Dryad Street near campus; no suspect arrested yet
item.description: This marks the second shooting case within the same week in a Houston-area school. Police are yet to reveal the identity of the 17-year-old victim.

item.title: Airbus detects quality issue in A321 neo fuselage coating; around a dozen IndiGo aircraft impacted
item.description: The issue is therefore being treated by Airbus as a quality and maintenance matter rather than an operational safety concern, with the manufacturer saying the affected aircraft can continue flying.

item.title: What is Bhajan Clubbing? PM Modi attends Delhi event marking Deendayal Upadhyaya’s birth anniversary
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended a ‘Bhajan Clubbing’ event in Delhi on Deendayal Upadhyaya’s birth anniversary. The format combines traditional devotional songs with the energy and production of modern concerts.

item.title: The death of distance: How Vande Bharat, bridges, tunnels and expressways draw Indian cities closer without moving
item.description: The impact is particularly visible on routes where rivers, mountains, traffic congestion and ageing railway infrastructure had historically added hours to journeys. Govt data shows that several major infrastructure projects have substantially reduced both travel distances and overall journey times.

item.title: Noah Woods death: Inquest hears how three-year-old non-verbal boy died in Suffolk Pond
item.description: At the inquest opening, DCI Matthew Connick said Noah Woods who went missing, escaped from the playground through a gap in the fence. A postmortem examination recorded his cause of death as pending further investigation.

item.title: Who is Mandeep K Bhandari? Meet the new CBSE chairman — an IAS officer with medical background
item.description: Bhandari's appointment comes after a period of changes in the leadership of the school education board.

item.title: US proposes new trilateral peace talks with Russia and Ukraine in UAE: Zelensky
item.description: The latest proposal therefore represents a further attempt to restart negotiations rather than confirmation of a peace deal. The date, format and agenda of any new trilateral meeting are yet to be finalised.

item.title: Weather tomorrow: IMD issues red, orange alerts across several Uttarakhand districts for Sep 26, 27; CM Dhami reacts
item.description: Uttarakhand Weather: The IMD has forecast red, orange and yellow alerts across 13 districts on September 26 and 27, with red alerts covering five and four districts, respectively. CM Pushkar Singh Dhami stressed the importance of caution and adherence to advisories amid expected heavy rainfall.

item.title: US Army plans for possible Cuba operation: Police, medical units could be ready within 120 days — Report
item.description: The military planning comes as President Donald Trump has intensified pressure on Cuba and called for fundamental political change on the island.

item.title: Dolly Parton Day: How Nashville is turning 25 September into a citywide tribute to the music icon
item.description: Dolly Parton Day is being marked across Nashville and beyond with concerts, themed events and fundraisers, as fans honour the late singer’s legacy through music and her long-running commitment to children’s literacy.

item.title: Putin's party sets new record in Russia election, United Russia wins 349 out of 450-member State Duma
item.description: Russia's final election results give United Russia a record 349 seats in the State Duma, while 46 Ukraine war veterans enter parliament.

item.title: Delhi HC issues notices to CJP leaders over alleged morphed pics of woman with PM, orders Meta to remove them in 24 hrs
item.description: The Delhi High Court issued notices to CJP activists regarding a woman's petition to delete doctored AI images of her with PM Modi. The court ordered police protection for her and directed Meta to remove the harmful content within 24 hours.

item.title: Watch | Nepal’s Bagmati River breaches levels in scary visuals amid heavy rain, govt activates emergency response
item.description: The Bagmati River overflowed its banks following persistent rainfall in Nepal, triggering landslides. Travel advisory has been issued.

item.title: Manipur: MHA declares majority of state as ‘disturbed area’ under AFSPA for 6 month from October 1: What does it mean?
item.description: The Ministry of Home Affairs has classified most of Manipur as a ‘disturbed area’ under the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958. This notification, effective from October 1, 2026, will be valid for six months unless revoked by the Centre.

item.title: Nor’easter to hit US East Coast with 60 mph winds, flooding, rain; Boston, New York on alert
item.description: The storm could produce wind gusts of 50 to 60 mph in some areas, raising the risk of tree damage and power outages. Norfolk, Atlantic City, New York, Nantucket and Boston are among the areas expected to experience impacts.

item.title: Tamil Nadu shocker: 40 students fall ill after dead lizard found in government school sambar; 2 cooks relieved
item.description: A lizard was found in sambar served to students at a government school in Tamil Nadu, leading to around 40 students falling ill. The meal was part of the Chief Minister’s Breakfast Scheme, prompting the removal of two cooks from duty.

item.title: Nagpur turns waste into 28 tonnes of CNG daily: Gadkari says 4,000 such projects underway across India
item.description: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari announced India’s efforts to convert waste into fuel, highlighting Nagpur's daily production of 28 tonnes of CNG. Approximately 4,000 projects are underway nationwide

item.title: Zelenskyy says Trump made ‘final decision’ on giving Ukraine Patriot missile licence — what it means for Kyiv
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says US President Donald Trump has made a “final decision” to allow Ukraine to obtain licences to produce Patriot interceptor missiles domestically. The move could strengthen Kyiv’s air-defence capabilities amid a shortage of interceptors.

item.title: Brij Bhushan sexual assault case: Women wrestlers challenge ex-BJP MP's acquittal in court
item.description: Women wrestlers have challenged the acquittal of former Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) chief Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh and co-accused Vinod Tomar in the sexual harassment case before the Rouse Avenue court.&nbsp;

item.title: Air India pilot fails alcohol test before Zurich-Delhi flight; second case of intoxication on duty after Delhi-Phuket in
item.description: According to officials, the pilot who failed preliminary breath analyser test, was immediately removed from the flight before take off to Delhi. He was referred for further medical evaluation.

item.title: Oracle, 21 firms to face IIT hiring freeze after reneging on job offers: Report
item.description: Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) have reportedly decided to stop cooperating with 22 companies in campus recruitment for the next two placement seasons after the firms failed to honour job offers made to students

item.title: ‘Logistical factors’: ECI postpones CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s 2 outreach events in UP amid dissent row
item.description: The Election Commission postponed two ELC conferences in Uttar Pradesh, citing logistical constraints. The announcement follows an Indian Express report detailing internal disagreements among commissioners, though the ECI maintains that such adjustments are normal.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe effect? Reputation at stake, food businesses become ‘more vigilant’, shift to monthly audits, says report
item.description: Strict enforcement of rules drew companies' attention as regulators in Maharashtra and elsewhere, including Jammu and Kashmir, Karnataka, and West Bengal, intensified checks on restaurants, food manufacturers, and quick-commerce operations.

item.title: Make in India turns 12: PM Modi highlights growth in manufacturing, investment and exports
item.description: PM Modi on Friday marked 12 years of Make in India, highlighting growth in manufacturing, investment and exports. Government data showed PLI schemes attracted ₹2.40 lakh crore investment, while electronics production rose to ₹13.11 lakh crore in 2025-26.

item.title: Pakistan striking Afghanistan to escape Makkah defence pact? Taliban makes big claim — what’s behind it
item.description: Taliban has accused Pakistan of striking Afghanistan to avoid commitments under the Saudi-Pakistan-Turkey Makkah defence pact. Pakistan says its strikes targeted military objectives after alleged Afghan aggression, while Kabul says civilians were killed.
